stays_only.body:
Confirmed and fixed in `41aec01b`. **Fix shape (4)** — the claim narrowed to what was measured.

The behaviour is right and stays: `old <= v < new` includes the old floor because a user pinned at exactly that floor is stranded by the raise. Only the naming was wrong. Renamed to `test_the_old_floor_itself_is_newly_excluded`, with the docstring now saying that it is the right answer rather than an off-by-one, and that the verdict is patch-eligible only because `16.0.0`'s own upload date predates the cutoff.

Your warning about a later reader "fixing" `judge` is what the second half addresses: `test_the_old_floor_being_young_makes_the_raise_breaking` pins the same case with a young floor, so what decides the verdict is visibly the date and not the old floor being special.
